    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    avatar
    Command to display a user's avatar image.
    ban
    Administrative command to permanently ban a member from the server.
    Bot
    Main class for the Discord bot application.
    clear
    Moderation command to clear messages from a channel.
    command
    Interface defining the contract for all bot commands.
    hello
    Simple greeting command that responds with a personalized hello message.
    help
    Utility command that displays help information for all available bot commands.
    kick
    Administrative command to kick a member from the server temporarily.
    mute
    Moderation command to mute a user for a specified duration.
    ping
    Utility command to measure the bot's latency to Discord servers.
    serverinfo
    Utility command that displays information about the Discord server.
    SlashListener
    Event listener for Discord slash commands and bot readiness events.
    threads
    Administrative command to display information about active threads in the application.
    unmute
    Moderation command to unmute a user who was previously muted.
    userinfo
    Utility command that displays detailed information about a Discord user.
